decl.text:
abeLayerGrow(
o_abeInputLayer o_abeOutputLayer
[ ?north g_sizeNorth ] [ ?south g_sizeSouth ]
[ ?east g_sizeEast ]
[ ?west g_sizeWest]
[ ?queue g_queue ]
)
=> t / nil

description.text: Adds shapes to the ABE output layer that are ABE input layer shapes that have been increased in size along one or more directions in the north, south, east, and/or west.

items.name: o_abeInputLayer
items.desc: ID of the ABE input layer.

items.name: o_abeOutputLayer
items.desc: ID of the ABE output layer.

items.name: ?north g_sizeNorth
items.desc: Expands the north side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.

items.name: ?south g_sizeSouth
items.desc: Expands the south side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.

items.name: ?east g_sizeEast
items.desc: Expands the east side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.

items.name: ?west g_sizeWest
items.desc: Expands the west side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.

items.name: ?queue g_queue
items.desc: A Boolean value that adds the function to the queue if set to t, rather than running it immediately. Functions in the queue are not run until abeRunQueue is issued.

arguments.text:
o_abeInputLayer
ID of the ABE input layer.
o_abeOutputLayer
ID of the ABE output layer.
?north g_sizeNorth
Expands the north side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.
?south g_sizeSouth
Expands the south side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.
?east g_sizeEast
Expands the east side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.
?west g_sizeWest
Expands the west side of the shapes by this distance, in user units. The default value is 0.
?queue g_queue
A Boolean value that adds the function to the queue if set to t, rather than running it immediately. Functions in the queue are not run until abeRunQueue is issued.

items.desc: The expanded shapes are added on the output layer or the function is queued.
The function was not successful because ABE is not initialized or there was an argument error.

returns.text:
t
The expanded shapes are added on the output layer or the function is queued.
nil
The function was not successful because ABE is not initialized or there was an argument error.

example.text:
a1 = abeLayerFromShapes( geGetSelSet() )
result = abeNewLayer()
abeLayerGrow( a1 result ?north 0.02 ?east 0.05 )
Adds shapes from the selected set that have been increased in size by 0.02 to the north and 0.05 to the east to the result ABE layer.
